purpose: Persist verified legislation changes, drafts, official explanations and effective dates as evidence for existing MIRLEX radar master index, ECO_EXPERT and ROP_EXPERT

records.npa_number: Федеральный закон 451-ФЗ от 04.08.2023; ПП РФ 675 от 02.06.2026
records.effective_from: 2025-12-31; current licensing regulation effective 2026-09-01; transitional completion before 2027-01-01
records.affected_obligations: Existing licensees conducting processing, recycling or neutralization of class I-IV waste must ensure equipment/installation and annual capacity details are present in licence register; if absent add by 2027-01-01 via license-register amendment application on Gosuslugi. Report ownership/legal-use basis, equipment name, ordinal number, commissioning date, quantity, annual capacity in t/year, addresses; by item or technology line where appropriate. RPN does not insert details automatically.
records.rop_relevance: Verify recycler's waste licence, listed equipment and registered t/year capacity against actual technology and ROP claimed recycling volumes; do not assume waste licence alone proves ROP eligibility.
records.eco_relevance: Licence register completeness and consistency audit
diagnostic_questions: Are processing/recycling/neutralization equipment and t/year capacity actually present in the official licence register for each site?
Do equipment names, counts, commissioning dates, legal possession documents, capacities and site addresses match reality?
For ROP recycler, do actual recycling volumes and product outputs reconcile with installed registered capacity and independent ROP-specific requirements?
records.risk: Missing equipment/capacity or mismatch with actual equipment may trigger licence compliance and inspection risks; do not assert automatic suspension or fine without case-specific legal basis.
red_flags: Equipment operates but is absent from licence register
Registered t/year capacity is less than documented throughput
Technology line and address differ from register
Operator assumes RPN automatically updates register
ROP recycling proof based solely on licence existence

policy.deduplicate_by: document identity + changed provision + effective date; enrich existing record and existing ROP/IND IDs
